node.statement: Endpoint bridge: because every entry in the minimum defining e_act is positive, e_act>0. If e<=e_act, halving the cutoff gives e<e_col, e<e_var, and e<e_as. Also, if C_col>0, then e<=1/(4*max(C_col,1))<1/(2*C_col); if C_col=0, the estimate |q_T(U)^2-||U||_{n,1}^2|<=C_col*e*||U||_{n,1}^2 is exact and directly gives ||U||_{n,1}=q_T(U). Hence the strict antecedents required by nodes 1.2 and 1.3 are satisfied even when e=e_act.
